prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: pale cyan. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them. Every cutout is matte paper reflecting only the room light, with a plain blank face: coin rims, document faces, screens and vehicle sides carry no lettering, numerals or marks.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons, tape, rubber stamps, string and pins, stencilled arrows, paper bar charts, stacked sheets, grid paper, torn strips, hole-punched tags, paper clips, in cream, black, pale yellow or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture and print dots.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip: one line, no wider than a third of the frame width, with safe margins, the chip sitting clear of the subjects. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw. When the beat marks a hero number, that number alone may be printed larger, up to half the frame width.
8. Compositions vary in scale from beat to beat: some show one oversized subject filling the frame, some a small subject alone on open ground, some several elements arranged as a diagram.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: pale cyan.
Subjects: a paper shopping cart; torn strips.
Opens on the two panels, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip slides off the top as the two panels fold together into a paper shopping cart; torn strips drop into it one by one and settle.
Ends holding on the loaded cart.
This composition is oversized: one subject fills most of the frame.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "WALLET SHARE".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "WALLET SHARE". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "Compliance buyers can also buy marketing tools from one vendor.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a cinematic, modern editorial paper collage shot, photographed as a flat lay under soft room lighting with a consistent light source from the upper left. <Picture 1> establishes the initial state: a pale cyan, single-color paper ground featuring a cream paper chip at the top with the text "2 WORKFLOWS", and two rectangular grid-paper cutouts with rough white torn edges separated by a black stenciled arrow. The camera is a Static Shot. Immediately upon the first frame, the cream paper chip "2 WORKFLOWS" slides rapidly off the top of the frame. Simultaneously, the two grid-paper panels fold and collapse inward with a fast, refined 2D motion design, transforming into a single, oversized black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of a shopping cart. This shopping cart cutout has rough white torn-paper edges and is plain and unmarked, with no logos or text. As the cart settles into the center of the frame, filling most of the lower two-thirds, several small, torn strips of cream and white paper drop into the cart one by one from the top, settling with slight overshoot. At the same time, a new cream paper chip lands cleanly in the upper third of the frame, featuring the extra-bold black sans-serif text "WALLET SHARE" in a clean, legible, and stable print. Every element, including the shopping cart and the torn strips, casts a small, soft shadow toward the bottom right. The video concludes by holding on this loaded cart composition. A male narrator (S1), with a warm, clear, and natural timbre and a brisk but unhurried speaking rate, says <d>[English] Compliance buyers can also buy marketing tools from one vendor.</d>

overall_soundscape: A sequence of tactile, physical sounds including the crisp sliding of paper, the rhythmic, soft folding of heavy cardstock, and a series of light paper-slaps as the torn strips drop and land inside the shopping cart. A faint, sticky sound of adhesive tape is heard during the transformation.
